description: This file defines the WorkShiftService class which provides methods for managing work shift data, including retrieving default start and end times, fetching shifts by ID, obtaining lists of shifts based on filters, and counting shifts. It interacts with a DAO (Data Access Object) to perform database operations and uses traits for configuration services.

classes.name: WorkShiftService
classes.description: Service class providing business logic related to work shifts, including fetching default times, retrieving shift details, and managing shift collections.

methods.name: getWorkShiftDefaultStartAndEndTime
methods.description: Returns the default start and end times for a work shift as a WorkShiftStartAndEndTime object.

methods.name: getWorkShiftById
methods.description: Retrieves a WorkShift entity by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getWorkShiftDao
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the WorkShiftDao instance used for database operations.

methods.name: setWorkShiftDao
methods.description: Sets the WorkShiftDao instance, allowing for dependency injection.

methods.name: getWorkShiftList
methods.description: Fetches a list of work shifts based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getWorkShiftCount
methods.description: Returns the count of work shifts matching the search filter criteria.
